figures.finding: A juvenile of 15 to 18 is employed only on a ministry work permit, with the guardian's or custodian's written consent and an employment contract the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation approves; under the Civil Transactions Law in force from June 2026 a court may authorise a discerning minor of fifteen to manage part or all of their assets, and acts within that authorisation are valid; no set-aside of earnings was found.

value.employment: MOHRE juvenile work permit; guardian's written consent; ministry-approved contract

figures.applies: The labour rule reaches every employment (performer, writer, director); a freelance commission or rights deal by a minor needs the guardian or the court's authorisation under the Civil Transactions Law (read in a law firm's note only).

sources.said: However, the law permits juveniles aged 15 to 18 to work under official work permits issued by the ministry, provided that the employer meets certain requirements, which include: … a written consent signed by the juvenile's guardian or custodian … the employment contract approved by the ministry and containing the signature of the employer and the employee.

Article (15) allows the court, upon application by the guardian, trustee, or a discerning minor who has reached 15 Gregorian years, to authorize such minor to manage all or part of their assets, subject to conditions imposed by the court.

figures.finding: No juvenile under fifteen may be employed and the ministry issues no work permit below that age, with no exception named for performing; from fifteen to eighteen a juvenile works on a ministry permit, never at night and not in industrial or harmful work.
figures.applies: The bar reaches every role. Whether the media regulator or a free zone licenses child actors under fifteen outside employment wasn't found (blocker).

sources.said: According to Article 5 of the  UAE Labour Law , it is prohibited to employ juveniles under the age of 15). Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation does not issue work permits to juveniles below this age, whether Emiratis or expatriate residents.
According to the law, juveniles may not be employed at night. They may not be employed in industrial projects, or in work that is dangerous or harmful to their health.
